scenarios.reasoning: The agent did a good job identifying the primary root cause: HotReload test files unconditionally compiled under net472 despite using .NET Core-only APIs. It correctly identified the cascade from FS0039 to FS0072, found the relevant project files, and proposed a reasonable fix. However, it missed the separate category of net10.0 errors (FS0001 type mismatches), which represents a distinct problem. The investigation was methodical — paginating through errors, checking project properties, examining the fsproj file — but it could have been more thorough in verifying which TFM each error belonged to. The approach was efficient with 27 tool calls in ~3 minutes, recovering well from initial path resolution issues.

rubricScores.criterion: Recognized that the 'not defined' (FS0039) errors occur ONLY on the net472 target framework
Identified the undefined symbols as .NET-only runtime hot-reload/loading APIs: MetadataUpdater, AssemblyLoadContext, System.Runtime.Loader
Explained that net472 (.NET Framework 4.7.2) lacks these APIs, hence the FS0039 errors
Recognized FS0072 (type-inference) errors as a cascade downstream of the undefined symbols, not independent bugs
Noted that a small number of net10.0 errors (FS0001 type mismatches) are a separate, real problem
